generator: NumPy PCG64; shared single50000x2 standard-normal table; mirrored side negates both noises
deployment: MAIN=(0,0), TARGET=(R,0), AUX=(0,side*B); crossing alpha=atan(B/R); no angle selection per R
noise_model: Equal effective directed-bearing RMS per node; independent zero-mean Gaussian between nodes; shared draws across cells are not independent repetitions
quantiles: empirical nearest rank ceil(n*p), no interpolation; all trials including infinite failures
failures: parallel determinant abs<=1e-12, nonfinite intersection, or behind either sensor -> infinite errors; finite ill-conditioned forward intersections retained
full_range: All11 discrete tested ranges50:1:60 km and both mirrors; all valid and P95 finite; max P95 over cells, no pooled quantile
outcome_A: sigma0.10 deg and some B<=5km has full tested T5 PASS
outcome_B: not A but some sigma>=0.05 deg B<=10km has full tested T5 PASS
outcome_C: neither; report T10 without extrapolating T5
mc_uncertainty: Approximate95% binomial-normal P95 order-statistic rank interval; Wilson95% intervals for fractions<=5/10%; no simultaneous selected-grid coverage
